# `silk/platform/windows/process`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Direct Windows child execution with explicit inherited handles and owned process cleanup.

## Details
Executable and working-directory paths use the machine namespace `/C:/...` or `/UNC/...`.
Arguments and environment values use canonical WTF-8. No shell or executable search runs.
Output pipes use overlapped reads so either stream can fill while the other is idle.
